signed_rows.behavior: ci.yml is named CI and runs prek, then knowledge, then the kmctl, kmaudit, repo and starter jobs, each test job running pytest with markers not integration in its own directory (packages/kmctl/tests, packages/kmaudit/tests, tests); the kmctl job installs just before pytest, and the starter job runs packages/kmctl/tests/test_starter.py -m integration.
